title: 街路凸面ミラー
description: 実際に凸状に湾曲した鏡面、ひさし、背面金具と固定支柱を備えた汎用ミラー。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Unbranded convex mirror with physically curved reflective surface, weather visor, adjustable rear brackets and anchored tubular post. Reflections depend on your renderer and lighting. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
